Mariahilf (06. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

District-level crime statistics reported by Bezirkszeitung (meinbezirk.at) in May 2025 show a near-doubling of car break-ins (60 to 100 cases) and a rise in reported rapes (8 to 10) between 2023 and 2024, alongside a drop in shoplifting. Mariahilfer Straße, Vienna's main shopping street, has seen recurring theft and pickpocketing reported by police in 2025, including a five-figure cash theft from a shopper in July 2025. Separately, Heute.at reported in February 2026 that Mariahilf ranks second among Vienna's 23 districts for drug-related offenses, identifying the U6 station at Gumpendorfer Straße as a recurring dealing hotspot where a passenger who refused to buy drugs was assaulted and robbed, and where drug use has pushed into building stairwells over winter. Daytime on the shopping street carries the ordinary pickpocket/theft risk of a busy retail strip; after dark, the Gumpendorfer Straße U6 area specifically has documented, repeated drug dealing and occasional violence. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, 24 May 2025 – "Mariahilf-Statistik: Mehr Vergewaltigungen, Autoeinbrüche fast verdoppelt"; Heute.at, 15 Feb 2026 – "Im Winter schlimmer – Mariahilf als Drogen-Hotspot"; vienna.at, 23 Nov 2025 – "Fahndung: Duo in Wien-Mariahilf soll fünfstellige Summe aus Tasche gestohlen haben".
